visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Five young men are positioned in a brightly lit indoor space. The main character in the center wears a white oversized t-shirt and a black face mask, standing prominently. Behind him, two men on the left wear orange and white t-shirts, and two on the right wear blue and white t-shirts. All individuals are wearing various styles of sunglasses. A large glowing neon sign displaying 'SB87' is mounted on the wall behind them. (2) The group begins a synchronized dance routine. They move their torsos and arms in coordination. The central figure points toward the camera while the others perform similar rhythmic movements. Lighting is consistent and bright studio-style, emphasizing their street-style clothing and accessories. (3) The movements transition into various hand gestures, including forming heart shapes with their fingers and waving their hands toward the lens. The framing remains a medium full shot, capturing their bodies from the waist up. Yellow text overlays periodically appear at the bottom center of the screen, providing rhythmic captions that sync with their physical performance. (4) In the final phase, the group continues their rhythmic swaying and posing. The central figure adjusts his stance slightly while maintaining a confident posture. The others in the background maintain high energy, smiling and gesturing dynamically. The video concludes with them waving goodbye and gesturing as if 'getting off a vehicle,' maintaining a playful and enthusiastic atmosphere throughout the sequence.

A male voice delivers a rhythmic, chanting narration in Mandarin with a high arousal level and playful tone. The vocal pitch is moderately high, and the delivery is rapid and enunciated, accompanied by the sounds of the group cheering in the background. (2) As the music continues, the lead male voice praises a subject named 'Qi Huang Di,' using an exaggerated, comedic style. The BGM maintains a steady tempo of approximately 128 BPM with a strong, danceable rhythm. There is a noticeable ducking effect where the music volume lowers slightly to emphasize the punchy vocal delivery. (3) In the third phase, the vocal delivery becomes more melodic yet remains highly rhythmic. The intensity increases as the group joins in with synchronized shouts of 'Wa-sai!' and 'Shuai!'. Throughout, digital 'whoosh' and 'impact' SFX are used to accentuate the transition points, and the signal-to-noise ratio remains excellent.
